SELECT
STG.[ID]
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ACCESS_FLAG],' ',''),''),0)) as ACCESS_FLAG
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ALLOW_PSWD_EXP],' ',''),''),0)) as ALLOW_PSWD_EXP
,convert(date,[BDAY]) as BDAY
,[BRANCH_ID]
,STG.[CD]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CHANGE_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as CHANGE_CNT
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CHNG_PSWD_FLAG],' ',''),''),0)) as CHNG_PSWD_FLAG
,[COUNTRY_NO]
,[CREATED_BY]
,convert(date,[CREATED_DT]) as CREATED_DT
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUMM_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as CUMM_CNT
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[DEL],' ',''),''),0)) as DEL
,[DEPT_ID]
,convert(date,[EFFECTIVITY_DT]) as EFFECTIVITY_DT
,[EMAIL]
,convert(date,[EXP_DT]) as EXP_DT
,[FIRST_NM]
,[GRP_ID]
,[IMAGE]
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INV_LOGIN_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as INV_LOGIN_CNT
,convert(numeric(1,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([IS_ALL_CORPORATION],' ',''),''),0)) as IS_ALL_CORPORATION
,convert(numeric(32,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([IS_LOGIN],' ',''),''),0)) as IS_LOGIN
,convert(date,[LAST_LOGIN_DT]) as LAST_LOGIN_DT
,[LAST_NM]
,convert(date,[LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT]) as LAST_PSWD_UPD_DT
,[LOCAL_TRUNK_NO]
,[MID_NM]
,[MOBILE_NO]
,convert(numeric(38,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OLD_STATUS],' ',''),''),0)) as OLD_STATUS
,convert(numeric(15,2),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OVRD_LIMIT],' ',''),''),0)) as OVRD_LIMIT
,[PSWD]
,[PSWD_ALT]
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RETRY_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) as RETRY_CNT
,convert(numeric(10,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([STATUS],' ',''),''),0)) as STATUS
,[SESSION_ID]
,convert(date,[SUSPEND_DT_FROM]) as SUSPEND_DT_FROM
,convert(date,[SUSPEND_DT_TO]) as SUSPEND_DT_TO
,[UPDATED_BY]
,convert(date,[UPDATED_DT]) as UPDATED_DT
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[VERSION],' ',''),''),0)) as VERSION
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as [BNK_CODE]
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as [SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,convert(date,[insert_dttm]) as insert_dttm
 FROM [BUSC].[BOB_TBLUSR_DELTA] DELTA
 LEFT JOIN [d360].[STG_BOB_TBLUSR] STG ON STG.[ID] = DELTA.[ID] 
    WHERE H = 'D'
